notes.title: The Blue Cut Hook [DEMO] is Live Now !
notes.content:
GREETINGS, TRAVELERS!ːsteamhappyː

First off, a huge thank you to all our amazing patrons for your patience while waiting to jump into the full demo. We hit a few bumps along the road (turns out Steam has a lot of requirements), but we’ve sorted it all out and we’re thrilled to announce that the page is officially live!

"Grab your gear and get ready for adventure your journey starts now!" 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3661420/The_Blue_Cut_Hook_Demo/

And once you’ve had a chance to explore, we’d love to hear your thoughts. Your feedback is like treasure to us,
it helps make the game even better!
